intro: I’m Evie (Yuxin) Hou, a sociology researcher working across social research and AI.
approach: I like learning unfamiliar things, trying ideas quickly, and following a good question across disciplines.
role: Third-year Sociology PhD student at Peking University · Visiting Student Research Collaborator at Princeton for one year.

projects.name: SSDataAgent
projects.summary: An LLM data-analyst agent for population-level social-survey simulation. Its public documentation describes a tool loop for inspecting data, fitting generators, and evaluating distributions and event ordering.
projects.note: Selected for its direct connection between social-science methods, agent engineering, and evaluation. Benchmark claims have not been independently reproduced here.

projects.name: Mind Imprint
projects.summary: An AI learning platform organized around structured thinking cards, research workspaces, and reflection on the thinking process.
projects.note: Selected for its concrete learning workflow and explicit separation of model decisions, interface rendering, and process records.

projects.name: AI attitudes across social media
projects.summary: A Weibo/Twitter analysis pipeline that uses a shared model and prompt, records provider provenance, and exports daily measures for comparison.
projects.note: Selected for its attention to comparable measurement and reproducible processing. It processes previously extracted data; it is not a crawler.
